{"files":[{"path":"index.html","append":"    <section class=\"history\">\n      <h2>History</h2>\n      <ul id=\"history-list\" class=\"history-list\"></ul>\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"history-clear\" class=\"history-clear\">Clear History</button>\n    </section>\n    <script>\n      (function () {\n        const STORAGE_KEY = 'tip-calculator-history';\n        const historyListEl = document.getElementById('history-list');\n        const clearBtn = document.getElementById('history-clear');\n\n        function formatMoney(value) {\n          return '$' + (Math.round(value * 100) / 100).toFixed(2);\n        }\n\n        function loadHistory() {\n          try {\n            return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) || [];\n          } catch (e) {\n            return [];\n          }\n        }\n\n        function saveHistory(list) {\n          try {\n            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));\n          } catch (e) {}\n        }\n\n        function renderHistory() {\n          const list = loadHistory();\n          historyListEl.innerHTML = '';\n          list.forEach(function (item) {\n            const li = document.createElement('li');\n            li.className = 'history-item';\n            li.textContent = item.label;\n            historyListEl.appendChild(li);\n          });\n          clearBtn.style.display = list.length ? '' : 'none';\n        }\n\n        window.recordTipCalculation = function (bill, people, tipPercent, total, perPerson) {\n          const list = loadHistory();\n          const label = 'Bill ' + formatMoney(bill) + ' · ' + people + ' people · ' + tipPercent + '% → ' + formatMoney(total) + ' (' + formatMoney(perPerson) + ' each)';\n          list.unshift({ label: label, total: total, perPerson: perPerson });\n          if (list.length > 5) list.length = 5;\n          saveHistory(list);\n          renderHistory();\n        };\n\n        if (clearBtn) {\n          clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {\n            saveHistory([]);\n            renderHistory();\n          });\n        }\n\n        renderHistory();\n      });\n    </script>"},"path":"styles.css","append":"\n.history {\n  margin-top: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #1e293b;\n  border-radius: 12px;\n}\n\n.history h2 {\n  margin: 0 0 12px;\n  font-size: 1rem;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n.history-list {\n  list-style: none;\n  margin: 0 0 12px;\n  padding: 0;\n  max-height: 160px;\n  overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.history-item {\n  font-size: 0.85rem;\n  color: #cbd5e1;\n  padding: 6px 0;\n  border-bottom: 1px solid #334155;\n}\n\n.history-clear {\n  width: 100%;\n  padding: 8px;\n  font-size: 0.85rem;\n  border: 1px solid #334155;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  background: #334155;\n  color: #f8fafc;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  transition: background 0.15s ease;\n}\n\n.history-clear:hover {\n  background: #475569;\n}"}],"verify":"grep -q 'recordTipCalculation' index.html && grep -q 'history-clear' index.html && grep -q '.history {' styles.css","summary":"Added a localStorage-persisted history section (last 5 calculations) with a clear button, plus a recordTipCalculation hook for app.js.","ledger":"History stored under key 'tip-calculator-history' as array of {label,total,perPerson}; tip.js/app.js calls window.recordTipCalculation(bill, people, tipPercent, total, perPerson) after each calculation."}
